name: GETASAP
long_description:
Founded in 2023, GETASAP is a San Francisco–based technology and supply chain infrastructure company transforming fresh produce distribution and freight.

GETASAP Fresh provides same-day delivery to thousands of restaurants and retail locations across the USA, sourcing directly from farms internationally and operating global cold-chain infrastructure. It also operates an AI-native freight carrier and brokerage, delivering reliable reefer LTL and FTL services powered by VoiceAI dispatch, optimized scheduling, and real-time operational intelligence.

launches.title: GETASAP ASIA: 8 Hour Distribution for Retailers in Southeast Asia 🏪
launches.tagline: We’re the Amazon for B2B, supplying corner shops, restaurants, and supermarkets, ensuring shelves never go empty.
launches.body:
**Hey everyone** [👋](https://emojipedia.org/waving-hand)

We’re [Raghav](https://www.linkedin.com/in/raghav-arora-516b1826b/) (17 y/o) and [Krishna](https://www.linkedin.com/in/pranavkrishnasuresh/) (19 y/o), the co-founders of [GETASAP ASIA](https://bookface.ycombinator.com/company/30598).

### **TL;DR**

**We are a tech-enabled distributor for retailers in Southeast Asia.** We use software to offer the lowest prices and 8 hour same day delivery to corner stores, restaurants and supermarkets.

**Today** **we supply** 40,000 outlets including 18 supermarket chains and hundreds of corner stores and restaurants. We stock 20,000+ SKUs from 270+ brands and operate several fulfillment centers across SEA.

**Ask:**

Can you intro us to CPG brands that could benefit from exposure to SEA market?

Can you intro us to retail chains that we could supply to?

Can you intro us to US retail tech executives?

https://youtu.be/dPhL1k2n1Y8

# **❌ The Problem**

Legacy distributors _don’t believe in tech_.

• Systems don’t talk to each other, so information is stuck in separate tools.

• Lead times are long and freight isn’t optimized.

• Forecasting is guesswork, which causes stockouts during peak season and costs stores significant revenue.

• Labor costs are high, much of the work is manual, and prices are managed by hand, so margins shrink.

# [**👷**](https://emojipedia.org/construction-worker)**The Solution**

GETASAP ASIA is a tech-enabled distributor for retailers in Southeast Asia, operating a network of optimized fulfillment centers that restock stores in under 8 hours at the lowest landed price.

Our enterprise-grade demand intelligence powers our 8-hour fulfillment model and enables real time stock tracking, automated reordering for stores, and forecasting that positions inventory close to demand—so orders move from purchase to shelf within hours and stockouts approach zero.
